known_issues: Deployment failed during Android App Bundle (AAB) packaging step; likely due to broken/incomplete frontend file or truncated/malformed large JSON question data from previous build.

existing_features.title: Repair any malformed or truncated quiz question data modules so the frontend bundler can compile successfully. Specifically verify that these files are valid JavaScript modules that fully parse and export a default array: frontend/src/data/questions.js, frontend/src/data/questions_class7.js, frontend/src/data/questions_class8.js, frontend/src/data/questions_class9.js, frontend/src/data/questions_class10.js.

Add a pre-build questions integrity check that imports all question datasets (Class 6–10) and runs the existing validation logic (frontend/src/quiz/validateQuestions.ts) to produce a clear, English error message and a non-zero exit code if any dataset is invalid.

Update the Android release AAB build workflow script (frontend/scripts/build-release-aab.sh) to run the questions integrity check before initializing Bubblewrap / building the AAB, and stop with a clear error if validation fails.

projectName: Repair broken quiz question data files to unblock deployment and AAB packaging
